validation.rule: SYSTEM.md 1.5: >=6 winners (breakout >= 50) from >=4 channels, no channel > 1/3, >=3 weak contrasts, drivers counted
validation.limits: 6 winners is the minimum; presence counted from vidIQ audits (one prompt), durations from metadata; climax position and escalation steps measured in 2 winners only (unconfirmed)

conflict_hook.label: free (winners 6/6, weak 1/3)
conflict_hook.target: the conflict is stated in the first 5 s; ours is spoken by a character (owner's rule, 2026-10-26), a production choice, measured in 2/6 winners

antagonist_or_spectacle.label: driver
antagonist_or_spectacle.target: a person or power opposes the hero from the first shots (a giant, a tempter, rivals, a crowd); the story is told as that opposition

acted_dialogue.label: free
acted_dialogue.target: characters act and speak their lines, lip-synced (our quality bar, lipsync_check.py)

host_on_screen.label: absent
host_on_screen.note: the Keeper is our own authenticity layer, at the close only (<= 25 %), not a measured driver

length_s.label: driver
length_s.note: 5/6 winners run 170-179 s; all weak <= 147 s, including the two from winners' own channels. Owner's rule: 100-150 s from part 7; the measured target is 170-179 s (the owner decides)

sound.label: hygiene
sound.note: orchestral score with choir swells and foley (armor, stone, wind) in every video

cta.label: free (winners 5/6, weak 1/3)
cta.target: one comment question at the end

escalation.label: unconfirmed
escalation.note: 3-4 rising steps in every audited winner (2/6 counted) and in the Sodom weak: hygiene at most

conflict_check.policy: AI label normal in the niche; no fabricated prophecy; Scripture paraphrased by winners, KJV exact here

script.note: beat map for our Short, from the winners' order of beats; times are shares of the runtime. Our own words; Scripture only KJV, exact (kjv_check.py)

beats.rule: the antagonist or opposing power on screen and speaking the conflict (KJV line where the text has one); no atmosphere, no title card
who, what is at stake, one question left open (what will God do / will he survive)
three rising steps of the opposition, each acted in dialogue and ending on a small hook; shots 2-6 s, cuts only
the hero (or God) speaks the key KJV line at the turn
the outcome shown, one beat, a twist where the text gives one
the Keeper (<= 25 %): one original insight from the KJV text (a detail most miss, why it matters, the link to the next story), no sermon; a comment question; tease the next part

ypp_layer: our own script and direction (Keeper commentary is original analysis, not a retelling)
